answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and drove meaningful first actions. Memory_86 demonstrates that shortening onboarding lifted early adoption. These are complementary levers. Activation messaging is lower-risk than promotional pricing (which could erode margins against competitor pricing pressure) and more targeted than broad onboarding changes. We verify memory_91 and memory_86 to confirm the causal mechanism and magnitude of activation messaging lift, then deploy a standard experiment applying in-product activation messaging to accounts showing early warning signs of low engagement. This directly addresses the 6% activation decline without requiring pricing concessions or complex new workflows. Referral incentives (memory_57) target existing customer leverage, which doesn't address the immediate activation shortfall. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to SMB activation decay. Promotional pricing is a last resort given margin pressure.
